lessons.fix: Use current scope revalidation through the view and private composite workspace foreign keys; mirror the view shape in test fixtures.
lessons.finding: The active canonical project identity is a security-invoker view, not a foreign-key target table.
lessons.verifiedBy: Full source migration replay and focused PostgreSQL/PGlite behavior tests

lessons.fix: Use explicit aliases, supported regex patterns with independent length bounds, and parenthesized JSON extraction.
lessons.finding: PL/pgSQL variable/alias shadowing, PostgreSQL regex bounds and JSON operator precedence caused executable failures despite plausible source.
lessons.verifiedBy: Passing migration replay and SQL behavior suites

lessons.fix: Persist a one-sender dispatch transition; require canSend=true and exact task/worker/epoch ACK. Unknown delivery outcomes retain resource claims for reconciliation.
lessons.finding: An idempotent claim alone does not prevent two coordinators from delivering the same worker request.
lessons.verifiedBy: Separate-session PostgreSQL dispatch race test and unknown-outcome unit cases

lessons.fix: Require a separately registered principal and an existing canonical exact-source verification PASS bound to the task requirements.
lessons.finding: Different worker names do not establish an independent verifier.
lessons.verifiedBy: Same-principal rejection and canonical PASS consumption tests

lessons.fix: Hash owner inputs plus row/header identity; restrict machine updates to designated columns using literal RAW values.
lessons.finding: Including machine-owned status cells in a spreadsheet input hash breaks the next legitimate sync.
lessons.verifiedBy: Status-refresh, owner-edit, malformed-row and formula rejection tests

lessons.fix: Keep Antigravity zero-turn authentication failure and offline ADB state explicit; do not claim review or device acceptance. Use approved publication alternatives without widening key permissions.
lessons.finding: Provider availability and process existence are not execution evidence.
lessons.verifiedBy: Actual SSM, ADB, Antigravity and GitHub publication readbacks
